How It Works

Three steps. No hassle.

01

Book Your Bin

Pick a size online or call us. We'll confirm delivery timing and drop the dumpster exactly where you need it.

Know Before You Load

What can go in the dumpster

Accepted Items

  • Household junk & furniture
  • Construction debris
  • Drywall & wood
  • Roofing shingles
  • Yard waste
  • Flooring & tile
  • Cardboard & packaging
  • Non-Freon appliances

Not Accepted

  • Paint & chemicals
  • Tires & rubber
  • Batteries
  • Freon appliances
  • Medical waste
  • Asbestos
  • Fuel & flammable liquids
  • Electronics (call ahead)

FAQ

Common questions

Our 20-yard dumpster is $370 for a 7-day rental with 2 tons included. Extra days are $25/day, and material over 2 tons is billed at $79/ton. No hidden fees beyond that.

Driveway placement usually needs no permit. Street or public right-of-way placement may require one — we'll help you sort it out.

We schedule deliveries daily, seven days a week. Call us any time between 8am and 5pm and we'll get you on the calendar as soon as possible.

We keep things simple with one 20-yard dumpster, sized to handle most residential and light commercial jobs. If you have something unusually large, give us a call and we'll let you know if we're the right fit.
